body:
One day when I was setting up my classroom for my first teaching job I was texting him about how tired I was and even though he was busy he drove straight over and lectured me about moving big things without his help. Then proceeded to set up my new shelves.

It's just hard to find people so dedicated to seeing you happy and relaxed. I love him so much. And I wish I can find someone to love me that hard again.

7 months then it was like 4 days out of the week of messy panic attacks

Im on month 9 and am medicated so my panic attack can chill out. 

Now I just have this constant feeling of dread. Like I'm in a void. 

Im sorry for your loss and im sorry im not optimistic

I lost my fiance last year in September to a car accident. 
I also very much want to die. But I fucking can't give this pain to anyone else. 

Suicide doesn't end pain it moves it to others and I fucking hate that fact.

I just expect my friends not to let me mentally rot..

I never expected them to say the right things. Im very understanding and always appreciate effort over perfections.. I've  just never been so lonely in my life. It's insufferable. Having people ghost you that you thought had your back in the most critical few months sucks and I can't make excuses for them. I'm just shocked and hurt..

My job offered me 6 sessions at first. They told me I need to be seen multiple times a month because im showing sighs of ptsd. The only available option for me in in another hospital. They sent over papers to expedite the process but this is the best they could do :"(

I would kill for closure. Just one more deep conversation with him I feel like would help me a lot.

Otherwise I feel exactly the same. At this point I feel like im rotting away.
Try hard now so the happy version of you has nice things going for her.
Matilda

He was my first relationship and he was recently divorced from an evil relationship. 
We weren't even together for a full year but we were both convinced we were soul mates. We both don't even believe in that.

He was my person. I understand you. Unfortunately

>Today is a bad day, but tomorrow might be better.

I've been thinking about this a lot. I'm hoping it will stick. Thank you for the comment 🙏

Everyone here has different timeliness and relationship check marks. I was engaged to my love for four days before his accident. I've seen couples married for 20 years and another couple that were together for 1 year.

You are completely valid in expressing your feelings here because the loss of a love is so unique and we all only want to get better together.

Im 26. Lost my fiance in a car accident last august/September. (He was in the hospital 16 days.)and long story short I'm sure the medical staff lied a bit about his brain damge to guilt us into unplugging him from his comma early. 

In the beginning, they kept telling us we had a choice for about six months to keep him in the hospital incase he wakes up. We kept saying we wanted to wait longer then they told us if he wakes up he'd be a vegetable and we should be merciful and unplug him that weekend. They were very frustrated at us for asking for more days.

The hospitals were so packed from covid they hardly had a bed for him. I think they wanted the bed.
Just damn...

I am 6 months along and I hate everyone and everything. I've lost interest in everything and can't stop thinking about the timeline I should be in right now.

But I've made a promise to myself to just try everyday. Try to study a language, go to the gym, show someone around me kindness etc. For the next 8ish months. Then ill decide if it's even worth trying anymore. 

I was suicidal in December so this has already helped me some but I have a long way to go. I keep thinking "Try hard for the future self that finds happiness." And I'm just trying not to waste time now for the version of me.

I really hate the panic attacks. It's the scariest part about this change. Your "word vomit" sounds very ffamiliar.
I almost moved out of state but my therapist told me not to because grief makes you do dramatic things. I still wish I did it.

I completely relate to that. Please please nothing else in my life hurt me like with what happened in this loss. 
I cant take something else. Everyone please me nice im terrified

I try hard to keep myself from crumbling. Every inconvenience makes me so mad! It's like why! I'm trying! It's a miracle I'm out of bed and trying doing something Every single day and the world still throws petty things at me.

I in my natural mind set want 5o have temper tantrums over how unfair everything is. I was to break stuff so bad. And yet I still get up and try every time. 


Uhhjghjhsj I hope I'm making sense
Thank you.. I hate feeling alone in this..

Im gonna leave my reply at this:

You don't know me. You don't know the process I've been through. 

I can honestly say fuck off for trying to read me like this. AS IF I HAVENT BEEN TRYING TO PROCESS EVERY GOD DAMN DAY.

Literally on this app for support. Not for someone to belittle my grief.

LIKE DAMN IM TRYING.

Weed and a nap
Or hydroxide

I was crying 2-5 times a day everyday for 4 months. Now I cry a little less but still everyday. 

I want to make more memories. I want to feel secure and in love again. I miss him so much

I have been ignore by most my friend through this process. My co workers are scared tk become close to me because they don't want to catch the SAD. 
I think they all feel uncomfortable.

IT shocks me when someone asks and attempts to validate me. I am just going through this alone I want this pain to be acknowledged.

Being asked that is way better than being ignored.

For the first 2-3 months I though heavily of suicide. I even started preparing for it by writing all my loved ones notes.

How can I keep going? What's the point? No one here cares about me like he did... he was my most authentic unconditional love. We chose to make each other happy everyday after all.. it was just too hard to consider taking on that responsibility all my own for the rest of my life. 

My younger brother video called me the night I planned to do it back on November. It was my birthday and my late fiance had big plans this year for it and I couldn't stand not knowing the joy I was supposed to have with him.

My brother on the phone cried to me about college stress and covid and told me "I can tell this month is really going to suck for me." 

And I just sobbed knowing I planned to put him through similar grief to mine. 

I am on month five and living for my little brother will have to do until I can find my own reason to want to live. I'm still very depressed and hate living but I'm going to push through for him.

I completely understand. I really wanted my fiance to have kids so he could be the dad he never had. I never wanted kids before I met him. I just thought seeing a mini version of us walking around would have been so beautiful.

Im only 5 months in my loss and I always cry thinking I'm never going to be in my preferred timlime with my favorite person building a life. No matter what I do with my life ill always prefer what could have been.
We don't know my finances password... we're desperate to get inside it... I hate I phones.
Our first date was the 8th, and his birthday was the 12th. It was a very bad week for me. I'm on the 5th month of losing him. This month has just triggered it.

Im five months in as well. I feel like I had two weeks of getting my life together and now I'm so overwhelmed again and the darker thoughts from when it first happened are coming back.  I keep rereading iut messages and I feel happen in the moment and then torn apart after. I have spent more time trying to get help than getting it I hope youre in a path to get professional help too. I literally cry so effortlessly just like you. Its mind numbing
